asideMouse.default: Drag a slide, click it to flip, then scroll.

asideTouch.default: Drag and tap a slide, then scroll.

finMeta.default: Slide 5 of 11 / Why We Keep Going Back

finText.default: Built from a slide script, presented in FormDeck's slide show. Both demos run in the browser with no install.

propDocs.slides: Array of {src, alt, title, kicker, line, meta, note} in desk order. meta is a list of [term, detail] pairs shown on the back of the card. Twelve slides fill the grid best; the picture is shown whole at 16 by 9.
propDocs.focal: Zero based index of the slide that stays when the others fade and then fills the screen. Default 6.
propDocs.headline: Array of headline lines (up to three); the last line takes the product tint.
propDocs.finMeta: Small caption above the closing title.

fallback: With reduced motion the deck draws three settled states by scroll position (pile, grid, one slide) and runs no physics; cards stay flippable by click or keyboard.
